title: Parallel $\mathcal O(\sqrt n)$ Overhead LSD Radix Sort
excerpt: We present Radsort, a variant of LSD radix sort, sorting data with $\mathcal O(\sqrt n)$ additional space. Radsort is stable, admits a simple implementation and is easy to parallelise. For arrays exceeding a size of around 2 MiB it outperforms a conventional out-of-place LSD radix sort.

Abstract:We present Radsort, a variant of LSD radix sort, sorting data with $\mathcal O(\sqrt n)$ additional space. Radsort is stable, admits a simple implementation and is easy to parallelise. For arrays exceeding a size of around 2 MiB it outperforms a conventional out-of-place LSD radix sort.
